label: Modular spaceship from kit parts
description: Kit-bash a spacecraft from POLYGON_SciFi_Space SM_Veh_Part_* pieces: one body, one cockpit at the front (+Z), one to four engines at the rear (-Z), wings in mirrored pairs on +/-X, optional landing gear under the body (-Y), and greebles on the hull. Use the mesh-analysed mating faces: a body has part.sockets (front/rear/left/right/top/bottom) and every other part has part.mount; place child at body_pos + socket.position - mount.position on the socket named by mount.parent_role (child unrotated, mount.normal == -socket.normal). source "aabb" marks a fallback face centre where no flat cap exists. All parts are authored at 1:1 - never scale. Complete SM_Ship_* prefabs are whole ships; use them as-is or as size references, not as parts.

steps.note: Origin of the ship. Everything else attaches to this body's part.sockets (fall back to bounds faces if sockets is null).
body.sockets[front].position - cockpit.mount.position (mount is the cockpit's -Z cap); overlap the hull by 0.1-0.3 m along Z if the cap is small (low mount.fit).

body.sockets[mount.parent_role].position - engine.mount.position (mount is the engine's +Z cap, parent_role rear; Engine_08/09 are pylon pods whose mount is their +X plate, parent_role left -- mirror one onto right). 1 centred; 2 mirrored on +/-X; 4 in a 2x2 block offset from the socket.

Each pick is a pair: instance once at +X, once at -X mirrored (scale.x = -1 or the engine's mirror). Root at body.sockets[mount.parent_role] (right for a -X root, left for +X) minus wing.mount; the root cap may be tilted (dihedral) -- place by position, keep the wing unrotated. Fins (equal side faces) mount by their top/bottom cap.
Only for landed / hangar scenes. body.sockets[bottom] minus gear.mount (+Y cap = top of the strut); one forward + two aft spread along Z.
Hull detail on body/wing upper surfaces; greeble.mount is its largest flat face (normal points into the hull). Keep clear of cockpit glass.
Optional. Mount on hull top/bottom centreline or wing tips.
Complete ships for scale comparison / background traffic. Not parts.
